title: Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施~Diamond Light Source
focus: 3 GeV 中能量儲存環的射頻、插件磁鐵、熱負載與 Diamond-II 升級工程~RF, insertion devices, heat load and the Diamond-II upgrade of a 3 GeV medium-energy ring
summary: 以 Diamond 的 3 GeV、561.6 m、24 單元雙彎消色散儲存環為對象，從 499.68 MHz 射頻與 936 個束團桶出發，理解中能量光源如何靠真空內波盪器的高次諧波取得硬 X 光、如何管理前端熱負載，再推導 Diamond-II 把能量提高到 3.5 GeV 並換成 DTBA 晶格後，發射度、光子能量與光束線必須同步調整的工程邏輯。~Using Diamond's 3 GeV, 561.6 m, 24-cell double-bend achromat ring, start from the 499.68 MHz RF and 936 buckets to see how a medium-energy source reaches hard X-rays through the high harmonics of in-vacuum undulators and manages front-end heat load, then derive why Diamond-II's move to 3.5 GeV and a DTBA lattice forces emittance, photon energy and beamlines to be re-engineered together.

units.anchor: 3 GeV 儲存環與 499.68 MHz 射頻~3 GeV ring and 499.68 MHz RF
units.title: 儲存環時序：射頻諧波數與束團結構~Ring timing: RF harmonic number and bunch structure
units.mechanism: 儲存環的周長與射頻頻率決定諧波數 h = C/λ_RF，也就是能放束團的桶數；Diamond 周長 561.571 m、射頻 499.680 MHz，迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz，最多 936 個束團，相鄰束團間隔 2 ns。1.4 T 的彎轉磁鐵決定臨界能量與每圈的輻射損失，而 300 mA 的儲存電流決定射頻系統必須送進束流的功率。使用者看到的時間結構（混合填充、單束團模式）全由這組參數定義。~Circumference and RF frequency fix the harmonic number h = C/λ_RF, the number of buckets that can hold bunches: Diamond has C = 561.571 m, RF at 499.680 MHz, a revolution frequency of 533.8 kHz, up to 936 bunches and a 2 ns spacing between neighbours. The 1.4 T dipoles set the critical energy and the radiation loss per turn, while the 300 mA stored current sets the power the RF system must deliver to the beam. Every time structure users see, hybrid fills or single-bunch mode, is defined by this parameter set.
units.model: h = C·f_RF/c = 561.571 m×499.680 MHz/299 792 458 m/s = 936；束團間隔 1/f_RF = 2.00 ns。臨界能量 ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×9×1.4 ≈ 8.4 keV；彎轉半徑 ρ = 7.15 m 時每圈損失 U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/7.15 ≈ 1.0 MeV，300 mA 下輻射功率 P = U₀·I ≈ 0.30 MW，尚未計入插件磁鐵。~h = C·f_RF/c = 561.571 m×499.680 MHz/299 792 458 m/s = 936, and the bunch spacing is 1/f_RF = 2.00 ns. Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×9×1.4 ≈ 8.4 keV; with bending radius ρ = 7.15 m the loss per turn is U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/7.15 ≈ 1.0 MeV, so at 300 mA the radiated power is P = U₀·I ≈ 0.30 MW before insertion devices.
units.verify: 用束流位置監測器的迴轉諧波或條紋相機核對迴轉頻率 533.8 kHz 與 2 ns 束團間隔；以填充圖監視器（快速 ADC 逐桶積分）確認填充模式；把射頻送入束流的功率與 U₀·I 比較，再用彎轉磁鐵光束線的吸收片穿透曲線反推 8.4 keV 的臨界能量。~Confirm the 533.8 kHz revolution frequency and 2 ns spacing from BPM revolution harmonics or a streak camera; verify the fill pattern with a fill-pattern monitor (fast ADC integrating each bucket); compare RF power delivered to the beam with U₀·I, and back out the 8.4 keV critical energy from absorber transmission curves on a bending-magnet beamline.
units.failure: 若周長因地基沉降改變而射頻頻率未跟隨，束流被迫走離能軌道，能量偏移經色散轉成軌道偏移，所有光束線的光子能量同時微幅漂移，卻沒有任何單一設備報警。~If the circumference changes through ground settlement and the RF frequency does not follow, the beam is forced onto an off-energy orbit, the energy offset turns into an orbit offset through dispersion, and the photon energy on every beamline drifts slightly at once without any single device raising an alarm.
units.misconception: 儲存環裡的電子是連續的電流，沒有時間結構。~Electrons in a storage ring form a continuous current with no time structure.

units.anchor: DBA 晶格與 Diamond-II DTBA 晶格~DBA lattice and the Diamond-II DTBA lattice
units.title: 中能量環的發射度與升級標度律~Emittance of a medium-energy ring and upgrade scaling
units.mechanism: Diamond 原始晶格是 24 單元雙彎消色散，水平發射度 3.14 nm·rad，垂直 8 pm·rad。發射度隨 γ²θ³ 變化：Diamond-II 一方面把能量提高到 3.5 GeV（γ² 增加 36%），另一方面以雙三彎消色散（DTBA）把每單元彎轉數從 2 增到 6，θ³ 的縮減遠勝 γ² 的增加，同時在單元中段多出一個直線段，讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改由短插件供光。~Diamond's original lattice is a 24-cell double-bend achromat with 3.14 nm·rad horizontal and 8 pm·rad vertical emittance. Emittance scales as γ²θ³: Diamond-II raises the energy to 3.5 GeV, a 36% increase in γ², but the double-triple-bend achromat (DTBA) raises the bends per cell from 2 to 6, and the θ³ reduction far outweighs the γ² increase, while a new mid-cell straight lets former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices.
units.model: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³，C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m。現行 48 彎、3 GeV：γ² = 3.45×10⁷，θ = 131 mrad，F_DBA = 0.0645，得 ε ≈ 1.9 nm·rad（實際 3.14 nm，因實際光學偏離理想）。Diamond-II 144 彎、3.5 GeV：γ² = 4.69×10⁷，θ = 43.6 mrad，同一 F 給約 96 pm·rad，理論極限 F_TME = 0.0215 給約 32 pm；設計值約 160 pm·rad 等級，比現行低約 20 倍。~ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³ with C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m. Present ring, 48 bends at 3 GeV: γ² = 3.45×10⁷, θ = 131 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645 gives ε ≈ 1.9 nm·rad (actual 3.14 nm because real optics depart from the ideal). Diamond-II, 144 bends at 3.5 GeV: γ² = 4.69×10⁷, θ = 43.6 mrad, the same F gives about 96 pm·rad and the TME limit F = 0.0215 about 32 pm; the design value is of order 160 pm·rad, roughly 20 times below today.
units.verify: 以 LOCO 把量測的軌道響應矩陣擬合成晶格模型，取出各處 β 與色散，再從 X 光針孔相機的束流影像反推水平與垂直發射度；比較擬合模型的自然發射度與 γ²θ³ 標度估計值，差異應能歸因於實際的彎轉磁鐵長度與色散分佈。~Fit the measured orbit response matrix to the lattice model with LOCO to extract β and dispersion everywhere, then infer horizontal and vertical emittance from X-ray pinhole-camera images; compare the fitted model's natural emittance with the γ²θ³ scaling estimate, and attribute the difference to the real bend lengths and dispersion distribution.
units.failure: 提高能量卻沒有同時重算所有波盪器的光子能量表與熱負載，升級後每條光束線的諧波位置與前端功率都偏離原設計，光學元件在錯誤的功率密度下運轉。~Raising the energy without recomputing every undulator's photon-energy table and heat load leaves each beamline's harmonic positions and front-end power off their original design after the upgrade, with optics running at the wrong power density.
units.misconception: 提高電子能量一定會讓發射度變差，所以升級不該升能量。~Raising electron energy always worsens emittance, so an upgrade should never raise energy.

units.anchor: 真空內波盪器（λ_u = 23 mm）~In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 23 mm)
units.title: 波盪器 K 值、間隙與高次諧波~Undulator K, gap and high harmonics
units.mechanism: 中能量環要取得硬 X 光，依賴短週期真空內波盪器與高次諧波。NdFeB 永磁與釩鐵鈷極頭組成的混合式磁列放在真空腔內，間隙可關到 5 mm；峰值磁場隨間隙近似指數下降，偏轉參數 K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] 決定基頻波長與各諧波的相對強度。基頻與奇數諧波在軸上最強，相位誤差則優先削弱高次諧波，所以磁列的機械精度直接換成硬 X 光通量。~A medium-energy ring reaches hard X-rays through short-period in-vacuum undulators and their high harmonics. A hybrid array of NdFeB magnets and vanadium-permendur poles sits inside the vacuum chamber so the gap can close to 5 mm; the peak field falls roughly exponentially with gap, and the deflection parameter K = 0.934·B₀[T]·λ_u[cm] sets the fundamental wavelength and the relative strength of each harmonic. The fundamental and odd harmonics are strongest on axis, and phase errors weaken the high harmonics first, so the mechanical precision of the array converts directly into hard X-ray flux.
units.model: 混合式磁列的峰值磁場經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]：週期 λ_u = 23 mm、間隙 g = 5 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 1.10 T、K ≈ 2.37；間隙開到 7 mm 得 0.74 T、K ≈ 1.60。在 3 GeV（γ² = 3.45×10⁷）取 K = 1：基頻波長 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 5.0 Å，即光子能量 2.48 keV，第 3 與第 5 諧波分別為 7.4 與 12.4 keV。~Hybrid-array fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)]: with λ_u = 23 mm, g = 5 mm gives B₀ ≈ 1.10 T and K ≈ 2.37, g = 7 mm gives 0.74 T and K ≈ 1.60. At 3 GeV (γ² = 3.45×10⁷) and K = 1, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 5.0 Å, that is 2.48 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 7.4 and 12.4 keV.
units.verify: 在磁量測台用霍爾探針沿軸掃描，計算第一與第二場積分、軌跡直度與相位誤差（目標小於 3°），並以此建立 K 對間隙的查表；裝機後在光束線用單色器掃描各諧波峰位，與查表預測比對，再量間隙改變時的軌道踢角以建立前饋補償表。~Scan the axis with a Hall probe on the magnet bench, compute first and second field integrals, trajectory straightness and phase error (target below 3°), and build the K-versus-gap table from it; after installation scan each harmonic peak with the beamline monochromator, compare with the table, and measure the orbit kick as the gap changes to build the feed-forward correction table.
units.failure: 束流損失打在永磁上造成局部退磁，K 沿磁列不再均勻，相位誤差上升；基頻幾乎不受影響，但第 5、第 7 諧波的通量下降數成，使用硬 X 光的光束線先發現問題。~Beam losses striking the permanent magnets demagnetise them locally, K becomes non-uniform along the array and phase error grows; the fundamental is barely affected, but flux in the 5th and 7th harmonics drops by tens of percent, and hard X-ray beamlines notice first.
units.misconception: 波盪器只是把許多彎轉磁鐵串起來，光譜就是彎轉磁鐵光譜的疊加。~An undulator is just many bending magnets in series, so its spectrum is a sum of bend spectra.

units.anchor: 射頻腔、電壓與動量接受度~RF cavities, voltage and momentum acceptance
units.title: 射頻電壓、同步振盪與壽命~RF voltage, synchrotron oscillation and lifetime
units.mechanism: 射頻腔不只補回每圈損失，還以電壓高度決定縱向的射頻桶大小，也就是動量接受度；Touschek 散射讓束團內電子互相把能量踢出接受度，壽命對接受度非常敏感。Diamond 以 936 個束團高電流運轉，腔體的高階模（HOM）會驅動耦合束團不穩定，因此 Diamond-II 採用高階模阻尼的常溫腔。同步振盪頻率是檢驗電壓與動量壓縮因子的直接量。~RF cavities do more than restore the loss per turn: the voltage sets the height of the longitudinal RF bucket, that is the momentum acceptance, and Touschek scattering inside each bunch kicks electrons out of that acceptance, so lifetime is very sensitive to it. Diamond runs 936 bunches at high current, where cavity higher-order modes (HOMs) drive coupled-bunch instabilities, which is why Diamond-II adopts HOM-damped normal-conducting cavities. The synchrotron frequency is the direct check of voltage and momentum compaction.
units.model: 取每圈損失 U₀ = 1.0 MeV、腔壓 V_RF = 2.0 MV（過壓比 q = eV/U₀ = 2）、動量壓縮因子 α = 1.7×10⁻⁴、諧波數 h = 936、能量 E = 3 GeV（教學假設）。射頻動量接受度 δ² = U₀·F(q)/(π·α·h·E)，其中 F(q) = 2[√(q²−1) − arccos(1/q)] = 1.37，得 δ ≈ 3.0%。同步振盪頻率 f_s = f_rev·√(α·h·eV·cosφ_s/(2πE)) = 533.8 kHz×√(1.7×10⁻⁴×936×2×10⁶×0.866/(2π×3×10⁹)) ≈ 2.0 kHz。~Take U₀ = 1.0 MeV, V_RF = 2.0 MV (q = eV/U₀ = 2), α = 1.7×10⁻⁴, h = 936 and E = 3 GeV (teaching assumptions). The RF momentum acceptance is δ² = U₀·F(q)/(π·α·h·E) with F(q) = 2[√(q²−1) − arccos(1/q)] = 1.37, giving δ ≈ 3.0%. The synchrotron frequency f_s = f_rev·√(α·h·eV·cosφ_s/(2πE)) = 533.8 kHz×√(1.7×10⁻⁴×936×2×10⁶×0.866/(2π×3×10⁹)) ≈ 2.0 kHz.
units.verify: 用 BPM 的縱向頻譜或條紋相機量同步振盪頻率，與公式比較以反推實際腔壓；改變射頻電壓量壽命對電壓的曲線，Touschek 主導時壽命大致隨接受度的三次方上升；以逐束團回授系統的頻譜偵測耦合束團模式，確認 HOM 阻尼有效。~Measure the synchrotron frequency from the longitudinal BPM spectrum or a streak camera and compare with the formula to back out the real cavity voltage; vary RF voltage and record lifetime versus voltage, which rises roughly with the cube of acceptance when Touschek dominates; and use the bunch-by-bunch feedback spectrum to detect coupled-bunch modes, confirming the HOM damping works.
units.failure: 腔體溫度漂移讓某個高階模掃到束團迴轉諧波上，縱向耦合束團振盪爆發，束團拉長、能散增加，所有波盪器的諧波線寬變寬，使用者看到光子通量在單色器頻寬內突然下降。~A cavity temperature drift sweeps one higher-order mode onto a revolution harmonic, a longitudinal coupled-bunch oscillation erupts, bunches lengthen and energy spread grows, every undulator harmonic broadens, and users see flux inside the monochromator bandwidth fall suddenly.
units.misconception: 射頻電壓只要夠補回每圈損失的能量就足夠。~RF voltage only needs to cover the energy lost per turn.

units.anchor: X 光針孔相機與發射度量測~X-ray pinhole camera and emittance measurement
units.title: 束流尺寸、點擴散函數與發射度反推~Beam size, point-spread function and emittance inversion
units.mechanism: Diamond 在彎轉磁鐵光口用 X 光針孔相機成像束流：針孔把光源投影到螢幕，影像寬度包含束流尺寸乘放大率、針孔繞射與幾何模糊、螢幕與鏡頭的點擴散。垂直發射度只有 8 pm·rad，束流只有十幾微米，所以必須先獨立量出系統點擴散函數再做平方相減；水平方向則還要扣除色散與能散的貢獻，否則發射度會被高估。~Diamond images the beam through an X-ray pinhole camera on a bending-magnet port: the pinhole projects the source onto a screen, and the image width contains the beam size times magnification, pinhole diffraction and geometric blur, and the point spread of screen and lens. With only 8 pm·rad vertical emittance the beam is a dozen micrometres, so the system point-spread function must be measured independently and subtracted in quadrature; horizontally the dispersion and energy-spread contribution must also be removed or emittance is overestimated.
units.model: 光源到針孔 4 m、針孔到螢幕 8 m，放大率 M = 2；量得系統點擴散 σ_PSF = 15 µm，影像垂直寬度 σ_img = 31.8 µm：σ_y = √(31.8² − 15²)/2 ≈ 14 µm；光源處 β_y = 25 m 則 ε_y = σ_y²/β_y = (14 µm)²/25 m ≈ 7.8 pm·rad。水平：β_x = 1.0 m、η = 0.1 m、σ_δ = 1×10⁻³，σ_x = √(3.14 nm×1 m + (0.1 m×10⁻³)²) = √(56² + 100²) µm ≈ 115 µm，色散項反而佔大半。~Source to pinhole 4 m, pinhole to screen 8 m, magnification M = 2; with a measured system point spread σ_PSF = 15 µm and an image vertical width σ_img = 31.8 µm, σ_y = √(31.8² − 15²)/2 ≈ 14 µm; with β_y = 25 m at the source, ε_y = σ_y²/β_y = (14 µm)²/25 m ≈ 7.8 pm·rad. Horizontally, with β_x = 1.0 m, η = 0.1 m and σ_δ = 1×10⁻³, σ_x = √(3.14 nm×1 m + (0.1 m×10⁻³)²) = √(56² + 100²) µm ≈ 115 µm, so the dispersion term actually dominates.
units.verify: 以已知尺寸的針孔陣列或以極低電流的單束團（束流尺寸幾乎純由晶格決定）標定點擴散函數；改變耦合（偏四極磁鐵）看垂直尺寸是否按預期變化；把針孔相機結果與干涉式或 X 光繞射式尺寸量測交叉比對，並與 LOCO 模型的 β、η 一起反推發射度。~Calibrate the point-spread function with a pinhole array of known size or with a very low-current single bunch whose size is almost purely lattice-determined; change the coupling with skew quadrupoles and check that the vertical size follows prediction; cross-check pinhole results against an interferometric or X-ray diffraction size monitor, and invert emittance together with the LOCO-model β and η.
units.failure: 把影像寬度直接除以放大率而不扣點擴散，垂直發射度會被報成兩倍以上；若螢光屏因輻射老化而變厚、變模糊，同一算法會讓發射度看起來隨時間變差，其實束流根本沒變。~Dividing the image width by the magnification without subtracting the point spread reports vertical emittance more than twice too high; if the scintillator thickens and blurs with radiation ageing, the same algorithm makes emittance appear to degrade over time while the beam has not changed at all.
units.misconception: 針孔相機影像的寬度除以放大率就是束流尺寸。~The pinhole image width divided by magnification is the beam size.

units.anchor: 前端吸收器與低溫矽單色器~Front-end absorbers and cryogenic silicon monochromator
units.title: 插件磁鐵熱負載與單色器熱管理~Insertion-device heat load and monochromator thermal management
units.mechanism: 300 mA 下一支波盪器的總功率達數千瓦，軸上功率密度達數十 kW/mrad²；前端的固定光闌與可動吸收器先截掉大部分功率，第一片矽晶體仍要承受數百瓦。晶體的熱變形正比於熱膨脹係數除以熱導率（α/k），矽在液氮溫度附近 α 趨近零而 k 大幅上升，所以第一晶體以液氮冷卻，把熱凸起造成的斜率誤差壓到微弧度級，保住單色器的能量解析與光束位置。~At 300 mA one undulator radiates several kilowatts in total with an on-axis power density of tens of kW/mrad²; fixed masks and movable absorbers in the front end strip most of it, but the first silicon crystal still takes hundreds of watts. Crystal thermal deformation scales with thermal expansion over conductivity (α/k), and near liquid-nitrogen temperature silicon's α approaches zero while k rises sharply, so the first crystal is cooled with liquid nitrogen to keep the slope error of the thermal bump at the microradian level, preserving monochromator energy resolution and beam position.
units.model: 總功率 P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B₀²[T]·L[m]·I[A] = 0.633×9×1.21×2×0.3 ≈ 4.1 kW。軸上功率密度 dP/dΩ ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×1.10×81×0.3×87 ≈ 25 kW/mrad²；0.2×0.1 mrad² 的光闌放行約 0.5 kW 到第一晶體。矽 300 K：α/k ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/150 ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W；80 K：約 0.5×10⁻⁶/1000 ≈ 5×10⁻¹⁰ m/W，熱變形約低 35 倍。~Total power P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B₀²[T]·L[m]·I[A] = 0.633×9×1.21×2×0.3 ≈ 4.1 kW. On-axis power density dP/dΩ ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×1.10×81×0.3×87 ≈ 25 kW/mrad²; a 0.2×0.1 mrad² aperture passes about 0.5 kW to the first crystal. Silicon at 300 K: α/k ≈ 2.6×10⁻⁶/150 ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W; at 80 K about 0.5×10⁻⁶/1000 ≈ 5×10⁻¹⁰ m/W, roughly 35 times less thermal deformation.
units.verify: 以量熱法（冷卻水流量與溫升）量前端吸收器與第一晶體實際吸收的功率，與公式比較；在不同儲存電流與間隙下量單色器搖擺曲線寬度與出射光束位置，熱凸起會使寬度變寬、位置偏移；用紅外熱像儀或晶體上的熱電偶對照有限元素模型的溫度分佈。~Measure the power actually absorbed by front-end absorbers and the first crystal calorimetrically from cooling-water flow and temperature rise and compare with the formulas; record monochromator rocking-curve width and exit-beam position at different stored currents and gaps, since the thermal bump broadens the curve and shifts the beam; and compare infrared thermography or crystal thermocouples with the finite-element temperature map.
units.failure: 冷卻水或液氮流量下降而連鎖沒有觸發，第一晶體的熱凸起斜率誤差從微弧度升到數十微弧度，單色光能量解析劣化、光束位置漂移，嚴重時晶體或吸收器局部熔損，整條光束線停機更換。~If cooling-water or liquid-nitrogen flow drops and the interlock does not trip, the slope error of the first crystal's thermal bump grows from microradians to tens of microradians, energy resolution degrades and the beam drifts; in the worst case the crystal or absorber melts locally and the whole beamline stops for replacement.
units.misconception: 單色器只挑出很窄的頻寬，所以幾乎沒有熱負載。~A monochromator selects a narrow bandwidth, so it carries almost no heat load.

units.anchor: 同一隧道換環：光源點與光束線匹配~Same-tunnel ring replacement: source points and beamline matching
units.title: Diamond-II 整合：光源點、光子能量與插件匹配~Diamond-II integration: source points, photon energy and ID matching
units.mechanism: Diamond-II 在同一隧道內更換整座儲存環，前提是保住既有光束線的光源點位置與方向，否則前端與光學全部重建。能量從 3 提高到 3.5 GeV 後，每支波盪器在相同間隙下的光子能量全部上移 36%，光束線若要維持原工作能量，必須改變 K 值（縮小間隙）或更換磁列週期；DTBA 晶格新增的中段直線段則讓原本的彎轉磁鐵光束線改接短插件，光源特性整個改變。~Diamond-II replaces the entire storage ring inside the same tunnel, which only works if the source positions and directions of existing beamlines are preserved; otherwise front ends and optics would all be rebuilt. With energy raised from 3 to 3.5 GeV every undulator's photon energy at a given gap shifts up by 36%, so a beamline that must keep its working energy has to change K by closing the gap or replace the array period; the new mid-cell straights of the DTBA lattice let former bending-magnet beamlines be fed by short insertion devices, changing their source properties entirely.
units.model: 光子能量正比於 γ²/(1+K²/2)：γ² 乘以 (3.5/3)² = 1.36。某光束線原以 λ_u = 23 mm、K = 1.7 的第 5 諧波取 7.6 keV（基頻 1.52 keV），升級後同一間隙變成 10.3 keV；要回到 7.6 keV 需 (1+K²/2) 也乘 1.36，即 2.445→3.33，K² = 4.66，K ≈ 2.16，從前述 B₀(g) 經驗式相當於把間隙從約 6.7 mm 關到約 5.5 mm。~Photon energy scales as γ²/(1+K²/2), and γ² is multiplied by (3.5/3)² = 1.36. A beamline that took 7.6 keV from the 5th harmonic of a λ_u = 23 mm undulator at K = 1.7 (fundamental 1.52 keV) would get 10.3 keV at the same gap after the upgrade; returning to 7.6 keV requires (1+K²/2) to grow by 1.36 as well, from 2.445 to 3.33, so K² = 4.66 and K ≈ 2.16, which for λ_u = 23 mm with the earlier B₀(g) fit means closing the gap from about 6.7 mm to about 5.5 mm.
units.verify: 升級前以雷射追蹤儀把每條光束線的前端光闌、第一鏡與光源基準點納入同一座標網，升級後重新量測，確認光源點位移在前端可調範圍內；每支波盪器重做 K 對間隙表並在光束線掃描諧波核對；對改接短插件的光束線重新量光源尺寸、發散角與功率密度。~Before the upgrade bring every beamline's front-end mask, first mirror and source fiducials into one laser-tracker coordinate network and re-survey afterwards to confirm the source shift lies within the front-end adjustment range; remake each undulator's K-versus-gap table and check the harmonics by scanning on the beamline; and re-measure source size, divergence and power density for beamlines moved onto short insertion devices.
units.failure: 若光源點在升級後偏了幾毫米而前端光闌沒有跟著重新對準，高功率的波盪器中心錐會打在光闌邊緣或真空腔壁上，造成局部過熱與真空洩漏，同時真正到達光束線的只有邊緣的低功率光。~If the source point moves a few millimetres after the upgrade and the front-end masks are not re-aligned, the high-power undulator central cone strikes a mask edge or the chamber wall, causing local overheating and a vacuum leak, while only weak edge radiation reaches the beamline.
units.misconception: 只要隧道不變，換新儲存環後光束線不用動。~If the tunnel is unchanged, beamlines need no changes after a new ring is installed.

units.anchor: 機器驗收與可用度紀錄~Machine acceptance and availability record
units.title: 頂注運轉、可用度與工程交接~Top-up operation, availability and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 驗收一座使用者設施不只看峰值參數，還要看頂注運轉是否把電流維持在窄帶內、每年排定的使用者時數中有多少真正供光、以及故障後多快恢復。頂注的頻率由壽命與允許的電流變化決定；可用度由平均故障間隔與平均修復時間決定，而每次注入的束流損失與輻射劑量也要列入紀錄，讓光束線的熱負載、劑量與資料品質可以追溯。~Accepting a user facility is not only about peak parameters: it covers whether top-up holds the current in a narrow band, how many of the scheduled user hours actually deliver light, and how fast the machine recovers after a fault. Top-up frequency follows from lifetime and the allowed current variation; availability follows from mean time between failures and mean time to repair, and the beam loss and radiation dose of every injection are logged so that beamline heat load, dose and data quality remain traceable.
units.model: 壽命 10 h、電流 300 mA：衰減率 300/10 = 30 mA/h = 0.5 mA/min；允許 ±0.5%（±1.5 mA）則每 3 分鐘補注 1.5 mA，注入效率 90% 時需 1.7 mA。可用度 A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR)：MTBF = 70 h、MTTR = 1.4 h 得 A ≈ 98%，年排定 5 000 使用者小時約損失 100 h。~Lifetime 10 h at 300 mA: decay rate 300/10 = 30 mA/h = 0.5 mA/min; allowing ±0.5% (±1.5 mA) means a 1.5 mA top-up every 3 minutes, or 1.7 mA injected at 90% efficiency. Availability A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR): MTBF = 70 h and MTTR = 1.4 h give A ≈ 98%, so about 100 h of 5 000 scheduled user hours are lost.
units.verify: 以 DCCT 的電流紀錄驗證頂注帶寬與週期；用注入前後的電流差與增能環出射電荷算注入效率；以束流損失監視器與光束線劑量計建立每次注入的劑量紀錄；統計一年的故障紀錄算 MTBF、MTTR 與可用度，並與驗收合約的門檻比較。~Verify the top-up band and period from the DCCT current log; compute injection efficiency from the current step and the booster extracted charge; build a per-injection dose record from beam-loss monitors and beamline dosimeters; and compute MTBF, MTTR and availability from a year of fault logs to compare with the acceptance thresholds.
units.failure: 注入效率因增能環與儲存環的能量或時序失配而掉到 50%，每次頂注的損失束流打在真空腔與插件磁鐵上，劑量上升、永磁退磁風險增加，光束線在注入瞬間的資料也必須丟棄。~If injection efficiency drops to 50% through an energy or timing mismatch between booster and ring, the lost beam of every top-up strikes the chamber and insertion devices, dose rises, permanent-magnet demagnetisation risk grows, and beamline data taken during injection must be discarded.
units.misconception: 達到設計發射度與電流就等於設施驗收完成。~Reaching design emittance and current means the facility is accepted.

example: 波盪器升級練習：Diamond 一支 2 m、λ_u = 23 mm（N = 87）的真空內波盪器，以經驗式 B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)] 在 g = 6 mm 得 B₀ ≈ 0.90 T，K = 0.934×0.90×2.3 ≈ 1.94。3 GeV 時 γ² = 3.45×10⁷，基頻 λ₁ = 0.023×(1+1.94²/2)/(2×3.45×10⁷) ≈ 9.6 Å（1.29 keV），第 5 諧波約 6.5 keV，第 7 諧波約 9.0 keV。升到 3.5 GeV 後 γ² = 4.69×10⁷，同一間隙的所有諧波乘以 1.36：第 5 諧波變 8.8 keV、第 7 諧波變 12.3 keV。總功率 P = 0.633×E²×B₀²×L×I：3 GeV、0.3 A 時 0.633×9×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 2.8 kW；3.5 GeV 時 0.633×12.25×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 3.8 kW，前端吸收器與單色器冷卻必須按 3.8 kW 重新核算。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Undulator upgrade exercise: a Diamond 2 m in-vacuum undulator with λ_u = 23 mm (N = 87) gives, from the fit B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λ_u)(5.47 − 1.8·g/λ_u)], B₀ ≈ 0.90 T at g = 6 mm and K = 0.934×0.90×2.3 ≈ 1.94. At 3 GeV, γ² = 3.45×10⁷ and the fundamental is λ₁ = 0.023×(1+1.94²/2)/(2×3.45×10⁷) ≈ 9.6 Å (1.29 keV), with the 5th harmonic near 6.5 keV and the 7th near 9.0 keV. At 3.5 GeV, γ² = 4.69×10⁷ and every harmonic at the same gap is multiplied by 1.36: the 5th moves to 8.8 keV and the 7th to 12.3 keV. Total power P = 0.633×E²×B₀²×L×I is 0.633×9×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 2.8 kW at 3 GeV and 0.3 A, and 0.633×12.25×0.81×2×0.3 ≈ 3.8 kW at 3.5 GeV, so front-end absorbers and monochromator cooling must be re-rated for 3.8 kW. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
history: Diamond Light Source 位於英國牛津郡 Harwell 科學園區，由英國科學與技術設施委員會與 Wellcome 基金會共同出資，2007 年初開放使用者，是英國的國家級同步輻射光源，以 3 GeV、24 單元雙彎消色散儲存環運轉，並於 2000 年代後期陸續建成三十多條光束線。Diamond-II 升級計畫於 2020 年代獲得核准，將以雙三彎消色散晶格把能量提高到 3.5 GeV 並大幅降低發射度，同時保留既有光束線的光源點。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~Diamond Light Source sits on the Harwell science campus in Oxfordshire, funded jointly by the UK Science and Technology Facilities Council and the Wellcome Trust; it opened to users in early 2007 as the UK's national synchrotron, running a 3 GeV, 24-cell double-bend achromat ring and building more than thirty beamlines through the late 2000s and 2010s. The Diamond-II upgrade, approved in the 2020s, will raise the energy to 3.5 GeV with a double-triple-bend achromat lattice and cut emittance sharply while preserving the source points of existing beamlines. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
